Look up a source equation from species and geographic codes

Source: R/stem-defaults.R
nvel_default_equation.Rd

Resolve source equation identifiers from species and Forest Service agency codes.

Usage

## Call signatures
nvel_default_equation(region, forest, district, spcd, variant = NULL, product = NULL)

Arguments

region

Required numeric or numeric-text whole-number region code from 1 through 10. Length one or one per input. Unitless.

Missing returns a missing identifier, invalid values stop the call.

forest, district

Required numeric or numeric-text whole-number codes from zero through 99, length one or one per input. Blank text becomes zero. Missing returns a missing identifier, invalid values are errors.

Unitless.

spcd

Required numeric or numeric-text species codes from 1 through 9999, length one or one per input. Codes identify the Forest Inventory and Analysis species. Missing returns a missing identifier.

Invalid values are errors. Unitless.

variant

Optional character geographic variant, length one or one per input. Default NULL, missing, and blank values request the source geographic mapping. Unitless.

Example: 'PN'. The source uses its regional branches rather than validating against one complete choice list.

product

Optional character product code, length one or one per input. Default NULL becomes '01'. Unitless.

This input is retained for compatibility, and current default selection does not use it. A missing product does not select another equation.

Value

A character vector of source equation identifiers in input order. Identifiers are unitless. A selected source equation can be unsupported by the package, so check availability before computing.

Details

Only length-one inputs repeat. Any zero-length input gives an empty result. Region, forest, district, species, and variant select the source's regional equation branch.

These codes do not infer a location from the tree measurements. Omitted required arguments are errors.

Status and missing values

No tree status codes are returned. Missing required geographic or species codes return missing identifiers. Unsupported returned identifiers give unknown_model if later passed to a stem calculation.

Review the assignment.

See also

check_taper_models() to validate assignments, nvel_from_fia_code() for an inventory equation crosswalk, nvel_source_revision() for source version.

Examples

## Load dplyr
library(dplyr)

## Resolve source defaults for the shipped input combinations
example_trees_pnw %>%
  distinct(region, forest, district, spcd) %>%
  mutate(model = nvel_default_equation(region = region,
                                       forest = forest,
                                       district = district,
                                       spcd = spcd))
#>   region forest district spcd      model
#> 1      6     12        0  202 F00FW2W202
#> 2      6     12        0  263 F03FW2W263
